newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Hartmann urges quick transfer to Euro money.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Hartmann urges quick transfer to Euro money.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Wendelin Hartmann said on Monday that the German central bank was studying measures that could be used to shorten the transition time to circulation of the single European currency.
Current planning calls for the new Euro and national currencies to be both in circulation for six months at the start of 2002, in a period known as "Stage 3B".
"The Bundesbank is reviewing the logistical possibilities for the transition to be quickened," he said. "I myself am convinced that the Bundesbank would like to see a very short Stage 3B".
Companies that deal with large amounts of physical currency, including retailers, have pushed for the new currency to be quickly introduced to reduce costs.
